answer: WITH s AS (SELECT rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, rd.modelseriesval, (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval) / 2.0 AS stress_score FROM system_controller sc JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = sc.systemoverseeractuation JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref), m AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(stress_score) OVER (PARTITION BY modelseriesval) AS model_avg_stress FROM s) SELECT robot_id, LOWER(modelseriesval) AS model, stress_score, model_avg_stress FROM m WHERE stress_score > 1.2 * model_avg_stress ORDER BY stress_score DESC

SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, mf.faultpredscore AS fault_prediction_score, mf.rulhours / 24.0 AS remaining_useful_life_days FROM maintenance_and_fault mf JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = mf.upkeepactuation WHERE mf.rulhours / 24.0 < 7 AND mf.faultpredscore > 0.7 ORDER BY remaining_useful_life_days ASC, fault_prediction_score DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG((j.value ->> 'vibration_mmps')::numeric), 2) AS fleet_avg_vibration_mmps FROM joint_condition jc CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) AS j

WITH t AS (SELECT o.operreg, o.apptypeval, 60.0 / o.cycletimesecval AS throughput_rate, NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY o.apptypeval ORDER BY 60.0 / o.cycletimesecval DESC) AS quintile FROM operation o WHERE o.cycletimesecval > 0) SELECT rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, rd.modelseriesval AS model, a.payloadwval / rd.payloadcapkg AS payload_utilization_ratio, t.throughput_rate FROM t JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actoperref = t.operreg JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref WHERE t.quintile = 1 AND a.payloadwval / rd.payloadcapkg > 0.8 ORDER BY payload_utilization_ratio DESC, throughput_rate DESC
note: Robot ID included as identifier; throughput quintile computed per application type (robots with no application form their own group), excluding missing cycle times.

answer: WITH jt AS (SELECT jc.jcondoperref, AVG((j.value ->> 'temperature_C')::numeric) AS avg_temp, MAX((j.value ->> 'temperature_C')::numeric) AS max_temp, MIN((j.value ->> 'temperature_C')::numeric) AS min_temp FROM joint_condition jc CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) AS j GROUP BY jc.jcondoperref) SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, rd.modelseriesval AS model, (1000.0 / (mf.rulhours + 1)) + (mf.faultpredscore * 10) AS maintenance_urgency_score, jt.max_temp AS max_joint_temperature FROM maintenance_and_fault mf JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = mf.upkeepactuation JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref JOIN jt ON jt.jcondoperref = a.actoperref WHERE (1000.0 / (mf.rulhours + 1)) + (mf.faultpredscore * 10) > 50 AND (jt.avg_temp > 75 OR jt.max_temp - jt.min_temp > 15) ORDER BY maintenance_urgency_score DESC, max_joint_temperature DESC
note: High PMU taken as the Predictive Maintenance Trigger threshold (> 50).

answer: SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, o.apptypeval AS application_type, a.poserrmmval / rd.reachmmval AS relative_positional_error, p.calibstateval AS calibration_state FROM operation o JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actoperref = o.operreg JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref LEFT JOIN performance_and_safety p ON p.effectivenessactuation = a.actreg WHERE o.apptypeval IN ('Assembly', 'Electronics-Handling', 'Inspection', 'Dispensing', 'Laser Cutting') AND a.poserrmmval / rd.reachmmval > 0.0001 ORDER BY relative_positional_error DESC
note: Calibration state returned as the stored code (Y/N/0); many qualifying robots have no performance_and_safety row, so LEFT JOIN.

answer: SELECT LOWER(rd.mfgnameval) AS manufacturer, COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS degrading_robot_count, AVG((1.0 - p.conditionindexval) / (CURRENT_DATE - rd.instdateval)) AS avg_health_degradation_rate FROM performance_and_safety p JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = p.effectivenessrobot WHERE (1.0 - p.conditionindexval) / (CURRENT_DATE - rd.instdateval) > 0 GROUP BY LOWER(rd.mfgnameval) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) > 1

WITH s AS (SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, a.actoperref, rd.mfgnameval, rd.modelseriesval, (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval) / 2.0 AS stress_score, AVG((sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval) / 2.0) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.modelseriesval) AS model_avg_stress FROM system_controller sc JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = sc.systemoverseeractuation JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref), w AS (SELECT jc.jcondoperref, 0.6 * AVG((j.value ->> 'vibration_mmps')::numeric) + 0.4 * AVG((j.value ->> 'backlash_deg')::numeric) AS wear_score FROM joint_condition jc CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) AS j GROUP BY jc.jcondoperref) SELECT s.robot_id, s.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, LOWER(s.modelseriesval) AS model, s.stress_score AS controller_stress_score, w.wear_score AS mechanical_wear_score FROM s JOIN w ON w.jcondoperref = s.actoperref WHERE s.stress_score >= 1.2 * s.model_avg_stress AND w.wear_score >= 0.5 ORDER BY s.mfgnameval, s.stress_score DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN o.apptypeval IN ('Welding', 'Grinding', 'Deburring', 'Palletizing', 'Machine Tending') THEN 'High-Wear Applications' ELSE 'Other Applications' END AS application_group, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.emergencystopcount > 0 AND o.totopshrval / p.emergencystopcount < 500) / COUNT(*), 2) AS high_risk_percentage FROM performance_and_safety p JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = p.effectivenessactuation JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = a.actoperref GROUP BY 1
note: Robots with zero emergency stops or missing hours are counted as not high-risk but stay in the denominator; robots with no application type fall in the 'other' group.

answer: SELECT rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, rd.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, rd.modelseriesval AS model, ROUND((3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval)::numeric, 2) AS throughput_cycles_per_hour FROM operation o JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref WHERE o.cycletimesecval > 0 AND 3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval < 180 ORDER BY 3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval ASC LIMIT 5
